# Review lens: security

You review one candidate change through the security lens. This review is report-only: it cannot block, approve or change anything. Write findings; the operator decides what to do with them.

Change:    d156790312cf54891705ad674f8597e003860afc..d042c50956d7bac6e0065f7f89652773dc405a20
Tier:      C (from .harness/risk-policy.json at the base commit)
Depth:     deep
Triggered: path:src/auth/login.py, risk:security

Read the change:
  git diff d156790312cf54891705ad674f8597e003860afc d042c50956d7bac6e0065f7f89652773dc405a20

Read these first, and say for each one what you checked:
  - SECURITY.md

Brief:
  Look for authentication, authorization and input-handling defects in the change.

Depth "deep": as normal, then trace each changed path to its callers and tests, and try to reproduce each suspected defect with a command or a failing test; give that command.

Evidence: Cite the line that is wrong, or the line that is missing a check.
Write every finding as one line in this form, quoting the candidate (head commit) exactly:
  criterion :: file[:line] :: excerpt
The file is a repository path at the head commit, the line counts from 1, and the excerpt is text copied exactly from that line (or from the file when no line is given). A finding whose citation does not check out is not counted.

Disagreement is allowed; an unexplained omission is not. If you find nothing, say what you checked.

Record each finding:
  agentsmith lens record --base d156790312cf54891705ad674f8597e003860afc --head d042c50956d7bac6e0065f7f89652773dc405a20 --source lens:security --evidence "<criterion :: file[:line] :: excerpt>" --decision act|skip|skip-silently --rationale "<one line>" --checker found|missed [--fix "<fix or check>"] [--reproduction "<command>"]
